scenario.zh: 为轻度听力损失用户选择合适的Legato配置，体验不同环境下的语音增强效果
scenario.en: Select appropriate Legato configuration for mild hearing loss and experience voice enhancement across environments

instruction.zh: 确定您最常需要听力辅助的环境
instruction.en: Identify where you need hearing assistance most

output.zh: 已配置室内模式：优先抑制持续背景噪音，增强近距离人声
output.en: Indoor mode configured: prioritizes suppressing steady ambient noise, enhancing close-range voices

output.zh: 已配置户外模式：平衡风噪过滤与方向性语音捕捉
output.en: Outdoor mode configured: balances wind noise filtering with directional speech capture

instruction.zh: 根据听力损失程度调整增强水平
instruction.en: Adjust enhancement level based on hearing loss degree

output.zh: 语音提升至清晰度优先级别，保留环境音自然感
output.en: Voice boosted to clarity-priority level while preserving natural ambient sound

label.zh: 中度增强（经常需要重复）

output.zh: 语音大幅放大，背景声显著降低，对话层次更分明
output.en: Voice significantly amplified, background sounds notably reduced, conversation layers clearer

instruction.zh: 查看两种典型环境下的处理效果差异
instruction.en: Review processing differences across two typical environments

output.zh: 前方说话者声音突出，咖啡机和背景交谈声减弱，言语辨识度提升明显
output.en: Front speaker voice pronounced, coffee machine and background chatter subdued, speech intelligibility notably improved

output.zh: 会议发言人音量提升，键盘敲击和远处电话声过滤，讨论内容更易跟随
output.en: Meeting speaker volume elevated, keyboard typing and distant phone calls filtered, discussion easier to follow

instruction.zh: 确认适合您的Legato设置组合
instruction.en: Confirm the Legato setup combination that fits you

output.zh: 配置已就绪：可通过镜腿触控调节，首次佩戴建议从低增强开始适应
output.en: Configuration ready: adjustable via temple touch controls, first-time wear recommended starting with lower enhancement

output.zh: 返回场景选择，可尝试不同环境与增强组合以找到最佳平衡
output.en: Return to scenario selection to try different environment and enhancement combinations for optimal balance

takeaway.zh: Legato通过AI分离人声与噪音，让听力辅助融入日常眼镜，不同场景和增强级别可个性化调整
takeaway.en: Legato uses AI to separate voices from noise, integrating hearing assistance into everyday glasses with customizable scenarios and enhancement levels
